title: Type impact
description: Big type. Opposing entrances. A clean final hold.
creativeDirection: Direction: a typographic poster in motion. Place MOVE at monumental scale on dark ink, with a lavender secondary word and one pink rule. Stage opposing word entrances with short ease-out-back travel; clear them together before the next beat. Follow with an off-centre pink scene and a calm final statement. Give every phrase a readable hold. Use native positioned text, bounded alpha and explicit entrance/exit times; no background footage, worker or new FFmpeg filter is needed. Review first readable frame, overshoot settling, coordinated exits and the clean closing hold.

title: Web App Promo
description: A cinematic app launch: masked editorial type, an uncluttered 3D screen reveal and a confident closing invitation.
creativeDirection: Audience: people evaluating a web app. Direction: a cinematic editorial product demo led by expressive type and the actual interface. Keep a continuous dark ink canvas, white condensed headlines, restrained lavender and a pink brand signature. Reveal the promise through a baseline mask, let a brief camera pull settle the opening, then move into a shallow perspective screen reveal that resolves to a readable flat view. A subtle forward drift adds depth without covering the recorded interaction. Finish with a large centered invitation and a stable final hold. Keep feature copy outside the capture. No decorative slabs, scene counters, fake window controls, oversized play symbols or bouncing geometry. Review the entrances, readable screen hold, widest allowed copy and final invitation. Preserve the existing native flat fallback on mobile; creative direction itself does not execute animation.

title: Product Launch
description: A minimal vertical reveal: large centred product typography, a clean full-frame shot, and an offer-led closing with fast, staggered motion.
creativeDirection: Audience: shoppers seeing one product for the first time. Direction: a minimal vertical reveal with the product as the hero, rather than a miniature web-app presentation. Use near-black surfaces, large centered condensed type and a clean full-frame product shot. Move quickly into the footage; make the closing offer and approved price easy to scan. Use one low-opacity shine sweep on the product reveal and a small overshoot on the offer; use staggered entrances sparingly and leave a readable hold. Avoid dense feature lists, fake discounts, covering the product and screen-recording chrome. Review product crop, longest name and price, type settling and the closing invitation.

title: Story Reel
description: A full-bleed three-chapter reel with alternating caption anchors, snappy opposing entrances and clean rhythmic cuts.
creativeDirection: Audience: people watching a vertical three-chapter story. Direction: full-bleed footage throughout, with alternating caption anchors and clean rhythmic cuts. Use readable, high-contrast captions as punctuation rather than turning each chapter into a title card. Oppose entrance directions to distinguish chapters; let the footage remain dominant after the short reveal. Avoid a repeated lower-third band, continuous shake and cutting away before the message settles. Review each chapter crop, text against the actual footage, the joins and the last readable frame. Alternate the chapter indicator side and give each caption one small overshoot, then hold the footage without decorative overlays.

title: Review evidence

Favor calm timing and cuts over promotional motion. Avoid invented test results, simulated interactions and decorative camera moves. Review the recording, readable context, review-focus text, scene joins and final evidence card.

meta.name: Before / after evidence
meta.description: House template for a UI change: the defect on the base branch, the fix on the branch under review. build.py composes every card and panel with ffmpeg and hands them over as project_video sections; LeClap does the watermark, the transitions and the join. Every value the engine would otherwise default is pinned on purpose: an evidence video has to render the same today and on a re-run months later, and a silent default change would alter the artifact a change was approved on. The two deliberate omissions are `look` and `grade`: a colour grade would shift the very UI colours the video exists to prove.

partials.description: A state card followed by its capture: the unit an evidence video repeats per side. Referenced once per side with a `prefix`, so the shape is declared once. `prefix` concatenates with NO separator, so `before` + `card` resolves assets/videos/beforecard.mp4.
